title: Electronic engine controls — 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT
introduction:
Ti-VCT means twin independent variable camshaft timing: intake and exhaust camshaft timing can be adjusted separately, changing when their valves open or close. I think of it as adjusting the engine's appointment book—the valve events can move while the engine runs.

That principle gives the engine label some meaning; the electronic-control operating description belongs in the manual reference below. This page directs your reading and contains no component descriptions, electrical tests or repair sequence. Keep the engine identification beside the reference when selecting applicable material.
